name: page_goto

provenance.source: exact xiaomi-band-10-3.1.28 IDB: body carries the goto_page_no_check_stacktop log tag

notes: manual static-test accept 2026-10-25 on the exact 3.1.28 IDB: goto_page_no_check_stacktop at 0xc4e0208 - looks the page id up with 0xc44c290 (registry list at dword_2008144c, key is the u32 at page+20 = page_id | app_id<<16), pauses the current page, runs the transition and the page enter callback. The ported 0xc44d504 is pagemanager show_app (app prelaunch), which is not a page push and kills the UI when called from a watchface. Restricted/PENDING; device not probed.
